sourceEvidence.label: FoodService partner authorization boundary at develop ee225bd

assessment.summary: Move partner authorization from convention to service-owned resource membership checks.

assumptions: No measured production load or selected compliance providers were supplied.

opportunities.title: Own partner authorization at the resource boundary
opportunities.summary: Authorize final restaurant identity against service-owned membership.
opportunities.diagnosis: Restaurant mutation currently lacks authenticated actor and ownership state.

evidence.claim: Restaurant mutations do not authenticate an actor.
Restaurant persistence has no ownership or membership data.
Gateway and service can drift because no component owns the full resource policy.

desiredInvariants: Every mutation authorizes the final restaurant ID.
Partner routes cannot approve or clear suspension.
Mutation and audit/outbox event commit together.

options.title: Gateway guards
options.summary: Authenticate and authorize only at the gateway.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Public calls narrow, but direct service bypass remains.

tradeoffs.assessment: Internet path is guarded; direct bypass remains.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Call gateway and service directly with the authorization matrix.
Compare p95 writes under target load.

residualRisks: Direct service bypass and policy drift.

implementationReadiness.rollback: Disable new partner writes; do not reopen public writes.

options.title: Service-owned membership policy
options.summary: Restaurant service authorizes membership and final resource.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: The resource service rejects unauthorized writes; legacy routes still require removal.

tradeoffs.assessment: Final resource is authorized at the owner boundary.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run role, tenant and direct-service tests.

tradeoffs.assessment: Transactional audit and outbox improve recovery.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Kill process around commit and replay outbox.

tradeoffs.assessment: Migrations and audit monitoring are added.

residualRisks: Compromised owner accounts, upload abuse and malicious administrators.

implementationReadiness.rollback: Disable partner writes while preserving data and audit history.

opportunities.recommendation: Use service-owned policy with gateway defense in depth.
